column1: # Invented words for the invented types in source-catalogue.example.txt. They keep the label rules under test and let
# the demo stack render without an installation's own labels.tsv.
#   object         what a case is about. Plural, because every screen counts them
#   event          a named fact. A completed fact in the past tense
#   entity, verb   the generic tier: one noun per entity, one word per verb, so an entity added later renders from
#   discriminator  the attribute that names the step — which role decided, which action ran, how it was decided
# Rules that hold for a real labels.tsv too:
#   * Where two types differ only by who acted, the label names the stage, never a job title the data does not
#     guarantee. The case view says who it actually was.
#   * Activities are singular: one thing happened once.
#   * The hint explains the step to somebody who has never seen the process, or is empty when the label is already
#     the whole story. A hint that restates the label is noise.
#   * Two event types must never share a label: that merges two steps into one line on every screen.
